title: The Black and White Polka Dot New Year's Eve Outfit
description: A black and white New Year's Eve outfit from Amazon: a polka dot square neck mini dress, a white cropped faux fur jacket, black patent Mary Jane kitten heels, pearl drop earrings, a black crystal clutch and sheer polka dot tights.
intro: Every New Year's Eve I swear I'll plan an outfit early, and every year I'm digging through my closet at 8:45 pm. Not this time. Black and white polka dots, a fluffy white jacket so I'm not freezing on the walk in, patent Mary Janes with a little gold buckle and a crystal clutch that sparkles every time the light hits it. Dotted tights because the dress deserved a matching moment. It looks fancy and none of it was fancy money.

sections.heading: The outfit
paragraphs: A black polka dot mini dress with a square neck and a corset bodice, layered under a white cropped faux fur jacket, with sheer black dotted tights.

sections.heading: The sparkly bits
paragraphs: Black patent Mary Jane kitten heels with gold buckles, gold pearl drop earrings and a black crystal clutch (7.87 x 4.33 in) that fits your phone and a lipstick.

sections.heading: Shop it
paragraphs: Every piece is linked below, and every look I make lives on my Amazon storefront: https://www.amazon.com/shop/thedigitalincomeedit
